About BuscaEM

BuscaEM indexes specialized national and international Mathematics Education journals using auditable publisher, OAI-PMH/OJS, SciELO and Crossref metadata.

Original-language metadata is preserved. English fields are shown only when provided by the source; BuscaEM does not fabricate translations.
